origin.description: Dependencies of packages in a package database.
origin.usage: package_dependencies(packages = NULL, db = NULL, which = "strong", recursive = FALSE, reverse = FALSE, verbose = getOption("verbose"))

arguments.name: db
arguments.text: Package database with Package and dependency fields.

arguments.name: which
arguments.text: strong, most, all, or field names.

arguments.name: reverse
arguments.text: When true, list packages that use the named ones.

origin.details: A version constraint in parentheses is ignored. The token R is not a package.
origin.value: A named list of package names.
origin.example:
db <- matrix(c("a", "b", NA, NA, NA, NA), nrow=1)
colnames(db) <- c("Package","Depends","Imports","LinkingTo","Suggests","Enhances")
d <- package_dependencies("a", db=db)
cat(paste(d$a, collapse=","), "\n")

translation.description: Dependencies of packages in a package database.
translation.usage: package_dependencies(packages=None, db=None, which="strong", recursive=False, reverse=False, verbose=False)

arguments.name: db
arguments.text: Package database with Package and dependency fields.

arguments.name: which
arguments.text: strong, most, all, or field names.

arguments.name: reverse
arguments.text: When true, list packages that use the named ones.

translation.details: A version constraint in parentheses is ignored. The token R is not a package.
translation.value: A named list of package names.
translation.example:
from tools.deps import package_dependencies
db = [{"Package": "a", "Depends": "b", "Imports": None, "LinkingTo": None, "Suggests": None, "Enhances": None}]
print(",".join(package_dependencies(["a"], db=db)["a"]))
